MEDIAWIKI_API_BOT_PASSWORD.description: The generated bot password from your wiki's Special:BotPasswords page

MEDIAWIKI_API_BOT_USERNAME.description: Your bot username, typically in format YourUserName@YourBotName

MEDIAWIKI_API_BOT_USER_AGENT.description: Custom User-Agent string for the bot (e.g., MediaWiki-MCP-Bot/1.0 (your.email@mediawiki.test))
